meta.title: Kamarob — a platform for nonprofits in Tajikistan
meta.description: A working platform for a nonprofit: public website, news and documents, member accounts, admin panel and team chat. Demo by SimorghDev with real photos from the Kamarob Gorge.

home.storyTitle: Six weeks in the Rasht District
home.storyText: During the holidays I spent a month and a half in the Rasht District, climbed about three kilometres up the gorge and spent a night by a spring that runs down from the mountain. Every photo and video on this site is from that trip.
home.ctaTitle: Need a platform like this for your organisation?
home.ctaText: SimorghDev builds websites and internal systems for nonprofits in Tajikistan and Central Asia.

demoAccess.title: Try it yourself
demoAccess.lead: Two ways to see the system from the inside.
demoAccess.registerText: Register with your email, confirm it, and you will see the member area with internal news, documents and chat.
demoAccess.adminText: Log in with the shared demo account. It can see everything but cannot change anything.

about.title: About this platform
about.lead: Kamarob is a demonstration of what a nonprofit in Tajikistan can run on one system.
about.p1: Many organisations working in Tajikistan's mountain regions have no website, or one that is out of date and cannot be edited by the team. Kamarob shows the alternative: a public site the team updates itself, and an internal space for members.
about.p2: The organisation on this site is a demo. The places are real: the photos and videos were taken by the author in the Kamarob Gorge in the Rasht District.
about.p3: The platform is built with Next.js and Supabase: accounts with email confirmation, a Postgres database where every table checks who may read and write, file storage and real-time chat.
